_note: German (de-en) profile: base Qwen3-TTS speaks German and the English narrator; no Russian LoRA. Select with OVERHEAR_RENDER_SETTINGS. Voices: synthetic or CC0 only (spec/voices.md); set clips.voices and forms.voices to the neutral reader once it exists. priority names the show to render first; replace it with your chosen show.

ttsRu._note: Target-language (ru) engine: ESpeech-TTS-1 RL-V2 (F5-TTS, venv-f5), reference-cloned from voices.json. Russian sentence cache keys use ONLY this block (not tts{}), so changing the English/narrator engine never invalidates Russian audio. Stress text = RUAccent on the sentence, with the notes' marks winning on homographs.

narratorRu._note: Narrator method B (narrator.py): English narrator lines that contain Russian words are spliced from English parts (F5 sky, ttsEn) and native Russian parts (Qwen3-TTS 1.7B + the stress LoRA, ruVoice), 150-250 ms apart, matched in loudness to the line they replace, 8 ms equal-power crossfades at near-silent joins. Each part is Whisper-checked and re-taken (takesPerRound x rounds); a line whose part never passes keeps its old audio and is logged to narrator-failures.jsonl and remembered per render key and version. stress: all | content | none. Does not enter the render key: applied after a scene is rendered, or later with narrator.py --scene/--season/--all.

lora._note: Stress LoRA switch. enabled=false until run 4 results are in. 'local' wins over 'hf' when it exists.

stress._note: policy: all | homographs | none | auto (auto = all when the LoRA is on, else homographs: the base model garbles text that carries a mark on every word, WER 0.84 in the qwen-ft eval).

stressRetry._note: A stress-flagged sentence is re-synthesised locally with different seeds/temperatures; the take with the best stress match is kept (and written to the sentence cache). No other engine is ever used in a scene.

clips._note: Audio for the lexicon's written examples (clips.py): one neutral dictionary voice per language, scene mp3 format, program loudness, Whisper-checked (CER <= cerMax), retaken up to `retakes` times, then dropped (no icon). batch: sentences per Qwen call (4 = 6.3 GB; lower it to leave room for the scene lanes).

forms._note: Audio for the forms in the lexicon's tables (forms.py): the clips' voice and format, but with the run3 stress LoRA on and stress policy 'all' (lora: false renders them on the base model). Whisper check on the form alone: CER <= cerMax after folding the unstressed-vowel pairs, with padSec of silence on each side of the clip for Whisper only. dictionary: Wiktionary's Russian inflection tables (wiktextract JSONL from kaikki.org, CC BY-SA; not in git, see form_dict.py): the stress of each table slot, first choice; null/missing file = RuAccent and the notes only. chunk: forms per GPU round (progress is saved per chunk).

gpu._note: VRAM reservations for pipeline/gpu/gpurun; one reservation per step per scene. Steps are separate processes so the MMS step of scene N can overlap the Qwen step of scene N+1. ttsMiB 6300 is the measured peak of batch 4 (6.2 GB; batch 1 peaks at 4.6 GB, batch 8 at 7.0 GB). Set tts.batch 1 and ttsMiB 4800 to share the card more.
